source: Sublime Text build 4215 / Color Scheme - Default / Mariana.sublime-color-scheme
authors: Sublime HQ Pty Ltd, Dmitri Voronianski
adaptations: ANSI slots reuse the original palette; there is no official Sublime ANSI mapping.
Workbench chrome uses shades derived from the editor background, inspired by Adaptive; it is not a pixel replica of Sublime UI.
Semantic highlighting defaults off to retain TextMate scope distinctions. Optional semantic mappings are included.
Sublime exclusion/disjunction selectors are translated to simple VS Code scopes and specific overrides.
Sublime token foreground_adjust and token backgrounds have no full VS Code equivalent. Diff editor backgrounds are mapped separately.
The 256-color cube and true-color colors emitted by terminal applications are not changed by a 16-color palette.
